name: Soulbound
source:
You awake in a hazy, confusing place. Somewhere familiar and yet could not be more strange. Little did you know that the crying in the distance would be your key to understanding everything - including who the shadow who haunts your dreams truly is.

[from [url=https://snakkiez.itch.io/soulbound]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你在一个朦胧、混乱的地方醒来。某个熟悉而又陌生的地方。你几乎不知道，远处的哭泣声将成为你了解一切的关键——包括困扰你梦中的影子到底是谁。

[来自[url=https://snakkiez.itch.io/soulbound]itch.io[/url]]
